description: This file implements a durable, persistent queue data structure with serialization, versioning, and log-append capabilities for use within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes interfaces, core class implementations, serialization mechanisms, and debugging views.

classes.name: IDurableQueue<T>
classes.description: Interface defining a durable, serializable queue with standard queue operations and enumeration.

classes.name: DurableQueue<T>
classes.description: A thread-safe, persistent queue implementation supporting versioning, serialization, and log-based recovery within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: DurableQueueDebugView<T>
classes.description: Debug view class to inspect items in DurableQueue during debugging sessions.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the queue and logs the clear operation to storage.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: TryPeek
methods.description: Attempts to return the item at the front without removing it; outputs true if successful.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given item exists in the queue.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the queue elements to an array starting at a specific index.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator that iterates through the queue.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the queue and logs this action.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the front of the queue, logging the operation.

methods.name: TryDequeue
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue an item, returning true if successful and logging the operation.

methods.name: ApplyEnqueue
methods.description: Internal method to enqueue an item without logging.

methods.name: ApplyDequeue
methods.description: Internal method to dequeue an item without logging.

methods.name: ApplyTryDequeue
methods.description: Internal method to attempt dequeue without logging.

methods.name: ApplyClear
methods.description: Internal method to clear the queue without logging.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage writer, asserting that it is initialized.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Method to create a deep copy of the queue; currently unimplemented.
